             artifact: true

+            bin: ./bin/godot.linuxbsd.template_debug.x86_64.mono

+            tests: true
+            artifact: true
+
+          - name: Minimal template (target=template_release, tests=yes, everything disabled)
             cache-name: linux-template-minimal
             target: template_release
             sconsflags: modules_enabled_by_default=no disable_3d=yes disable_advanced_gui=yes deprecated=no minizip=no

+            bin: ./bin/godot.linuxbsd.template_release.x86_64
+            tests: false  # Needs various fixes to work on minimal builds.
body: Unlike the `4.2` PR, I didn't enable tests here for the minimal template build, as multiple PRs would need to be backported for it, and that's outside the scope of what I wanted to do with this CI sync.
